run_bm_rasterize_meshes: run the bm_rasterize_meshes benchmark for Python, CPU, and CUDA mesh rasterization
benchmark_rasterize_meshes_python: benchmark the Python rasterize meshes implementation with small icosahedron meshes
benchmark_rasterize_meshes_cpu: benchmark the CPU rasterize meshes implementation across multiple image sizes and face counts
benchmark_rasterize_meshes_cuda: benchmark the CUDA rasterize meshes implementation with large icosahedron meshes on GPU
benchmark_rasterize_meshes_clipping: benchmark CUDA mesh rasterization with image plane clipping at various distances
